arXiv:2602.01149v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Machine learning (ML) has emerged as a powerful approach for accelerating the discovery of thermoelectric (TE) materials, yet many models suffer from limited generalizability. arXiv:2610.13795v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dopants can tune the activity of zirconia-based CO₂ hydrogenation catalysts through changes in adsorbate and transition-state (TS) energetics. Computing these quantities with density functional theory (DFT) becomes expensive when several dopants, reaction intermediates, and TSs must be screened. arXiv:2610.13754v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A novel physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) based approach for solving functional renormalization group flow equations is presented. Our technique relies on a series of ansätze that combines the small- and large-field approximation schemes with a neural network, leading to a highly accurate approximation over the entire field range. arXiv:2610.12766v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learning models for perovskite solar cells are typically evaluated using random data splits, which we show systematically leak information through massive internal duplication.
